samples.summary: New skill `slides-author.md` is not registered in the skills index and has no YAML frontmatter, so the skill-discovery contract every other skill follows is broken for it
samples.evidence: `packages/cli/skills/SKILL.md:36-43` lists the Slides skills (`slides-manage.md`, `slides-read-content.md`, `slides-import-pptx.md`, `slides-export-pptx.md`) and `SKILL.md:9-11` states "Every skill has YAML frontmatter with `name`, `description`, `safety`, and `tools` fields". Compare `packages/cli/skills/slides-export-pptx.md:1-7`, which opens with that frontmatter block. The new `packages/cli/skills/slides-author.md:1` starts directly with `# Skill: authoring native Wafflebase slides` — no frontmatter — and no row was added to the SKILL.md table. An agent that loads skills from the index (or filters by frontmatter `name`) will never see this file; `packages/cli/README.md:249-252` points readers at `skills/SKILL.md` as the catalogue. Fix belongs on the new file plus the index table.
searchedFor: Grep 'skills' in packages/cli/**/*.ts and repo *.json/*.mjs for a loader/validator

samples.summary: Brief coverage is only checked brief→template; two existing slides templates have no brief and nothing fails when a future template ships without one
samples.evidence: `briefs.spec.ts:10-14` asserts every brief maps to an existing slides template, but never the reverse. `TEMPLATE_CATALOG` (packages/backend/src/template/seed/catalog/index.ts:44-63) now holds 19 slides templates while `TEMPLATE_BRIEFS` (briefs.ts:33-52) holds 17: `weekly-business-review` and `project-kickoff` (catalog/slides.ts:6, :71) have no brief, so `getTemplateBrief()` returns `undefined` for them. Any consumer written against "a fillable slides template has a brief" gets a silent undefined, and the gap is invisible to CI.
searchedFor: Grep "^  title: '" and slug lists in catalog/*

samples.summary: Slide-size constants are re-declared locally (SW=1920/SH=1080) instead of importing the exported SLIDE_WIDTH / SLIDE_HEIGHT, so decor geometry will drift from the model that owns it
samples.evidence: `packages/slides/src/model/presentation.ts:92-94` documents `SLIDE_WIDTH` (1920) / `SLIDE_HEIGHT` (1080) as the canonical logical canvas, and `packages/slides/src/model/layout.ts:200-216` (`scaleLayoutsToHeight`) exists precisely because layout geometry is expressed against that 1080 baseline and must be rescaled for non-16:9 decks. The new `SW`/`SH` literals in `builders.ts:167-168` are a second copy: they are not scaled with the layouts, and a change to the canonical constants would silently leave every decor shape in the catalogue mis-sized. Fix belongs on the new code — import the constants from `@wafflebase/slides`.

samples.summary: The whole brief surface (brief.ts + 4 briefs-*.ts + briefs.ts) has no consumer anywhere except its own spec
samples.evidence: A repo-wide grep for `TEMPLATE_BRIEFS` / `getTemplateBrief` returns only `catalog/briefs.ts` and `catalog/briefs.spec.ts`; `catalog/index.ts` does not import them, so neither `seed-templates.ts` nor `register-templates.ts` (the two knip entries under `src/template/seed/*-templates.ts`, knip.json:25) reaches these files, and no frontend/CLI code imports them either. `FieldType` (brief.ts:13) is exported but used only inside its own module. This is a new unreferenced module tree — a risk for knip's unused-file/unused-export lane and dead surface for future readers.
searchedFor: Read knip.json workspace entries for packages/backend

samples.summary: Catalogue README's "Adding one" procedure is out of step with the new layout (per-kind file list, no mention of briefs)
samples.evidence: `catalog/README.md:29-34` tells a contributor to add a `TemplateSeed` to `slides.ts` / `sheets.ts` / `docs.ts` / `note-and-board.ts` and register it in `index.ts`. The change adds four more slides files (`slides-more.ts`, `slides-education.ts`, `slides-work.ts`, `slides-market-finance.ts`) and a parallel brief registry (`briefs.ts`) that the procedure never mentions, so the next template follows the documented steps and ships with no brief. The same gap is in the new skill doc (`packages/cli/skills/slides-author.md`, "Seed-catalogue form"), which also names only `catalog/slides.ts` and `catalog/index.ts`.
searchedFor: Read packages/cli/skills/slides-author.md section headings from the diff
